hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: Our passion for discovering the world

about.title: Travel with those who know the way
about.p1lead: Travelling is much more than reaching a destination. It's discovering cultures, creating memories and living experiences that last forever.
about.p1: Our passion for exploring the world has taken us to countless countries. Every trip has been an opportunity to learn, connect with new cultures and understand what transforms a journey into a truly unforgettable experience.
about.p2Start: Egypt holds a very special place in our story.
about.p2Rest: For over nine years we have visited it annually and it has become our second home. On every adventure, we also take the opportunity to discover a new destination, constantly enriching our experience as travel professionals.
about.p3: This journey, combined with our direct relationship with a fully trusted local operator in Egypt, allows us to design carefully planned trips to
about.p3End: . Each itinerary has been selected with dedication to offer an authentic experience, combining must-see places with hidden gems that can only be discovered through deep knowledge of the destination.
about.p4: Our commitment goes beyond organising a trip. We accompany you before, during and after your experience, sharing recommendations based on real experiences, providing personalised guidance and giving you the peace of mind of having a team that knows every destination first-hand.
about.quote: "Because when you travel with those who have walked the path, every detail makes a difference."
about.p5: Our greatest satisfaction is helping you live an authentic, safe and unforgettable trip, so you return with much more than photographs: with memories and experiences that will stay with you for life.
about.jessicaBio: Jessica is the creative mind and principal operator behind Sueño Travel Chile. With over nine years of experience travelling to Egypt annually and a close relationship with local operators, Jessica personally designs every itinerary and supports our travellers with expert, first-hand guidance.
about.photosCaption: Our adventures and experiences exploring the world.

blog.title: Experience Journal
blog.subtitle: Stories, travel tips and exclusive experiences shared by those who live the destinations first-hand.
blog.card1Title: Magical Egypt: The Legacy of the Pharaohs
blog.card1Desc: Discover why Egypt remains one of the most fascinating destinations on the planet. Join me to explore its history, colossal temples and the magic of the Nile river.
blog.card2Title: Turkey: A Bridge of Cultures and Colours
blog.card2Desc: From the bustle of Istanbul's bazaars to the lunar valleys of Cappadocia. A visual and sensory journey through lands of legends.
blog.card3Title: Discover the world in good company
blog.card3Desc: Travelling in a group is much more than sharing an itinerary. It's making friendships, discovering new cultures and living unforgettable moments with the complete peace of mind of having an expert guide.

footer.descripcion: Sueño Travel is your gateway to unique experiences around the world. With tailor-made trips, personalized service and a team passionate about tourism, we make your dream trip a reality, combining comfort, culture and adventure at every destination.
